subject: Intro: Aligning stakeholders & timelines for Zenwell evaluation
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Stone <alicia.stone@zenwellhealth.com>, Tom Becker <t.becker@zenwellhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Aligning stakeholders & timelines for Zenwell evaluation

Hi Alicia (and Tom),

Thanks again for taking the demo yesterday — great conversation. Per our ask, I wanted to put a short kickoff note on behalf of Redwood to align roles, objectives, and an initial timeline so we can keep the evaluation scoped and predictable.

High-level goals (from yesterday):
- Validate hallucination mitigation on patient-facing summaries
- Measure 99th percentile latency at peak loads for 512-token requests
- Estimate per-token unit cost at projected Q1 2026 volumes

Proposed timeline:
1) Week of 9/15 — formal MAP sent and stakeholder roster agreed
2) 9/22–10/3 — bench+app evals (shared test prompts & metrics)
3) 10/6 — internal results review and any follow-up requests
4) 10/15 — decision point / procurement kickoff (if positive)

Attached is a first-pass MAP and an evaluation checklist to make review quicker. Can you confirm: (a) that you are the primary champion for the project, (b) if Tom should be included as procurement lead, and (c) whether the proposed decision date (10/15) maps to your internal timeline?

Next steps from our side once we confirm stakeholders: send a refined MAP with owner assignments, set up a 30-min sync for test plan alignment, and provision an evaluation workspace with example prompts.

Thanks — looking forward to working with you.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri yom.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
[Attachment: Zenwell_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (PDF, 94 KB); redwood-eval-checklist.xlsx (Excel, 21 KB)]

From: Alicia Stone <alicia.stone@zenwellhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Becker <t.becker@zenwellhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Aligning stakeholders & timelines for Zenwell evaluation

On Wed, Sep 10, 2025 at 9:12 AM Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for taking the demo yesterday — great conversation. Per our ask, I wanted to put a short kickoff note on behalf of Redwood to align roles, objectives, and an initial timeline so we can keep the evaluation scoped and predictable.
> 
> High-level goals (from yesterday):
> - Validate hallucination mitigation on patient-facing summaries
> - Measure 99th percentile latency at peak loads for 512-token requests
> - Estimate per-token unit cost at projected Q1 2026 volumes

Thanks, Priyom — this is very helpful. I can be the internal champion and will own clinical acceptance criteria.

Tom — looping you in for procurement and contracting cadence (Tom is our procurement manager). Our ideal business decision milestone is end of October, so the 10/15 date is a little early — could we aim for an internal decision week of 10/27 instead? That gives us time for an internal security review and a quick SOC 2 evidence request.

A couple quick asks:
- Can you add a line in the MAP for security evidence/contacts so we know who to ping?
- Confirm if Redwood can supply an isolated eval workspace (VPC-perimeter) for PHI-like sample data — even if masked — during the bench tests.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call next week to align owners if useful.

Best,
Alicia Stone
Director of Clinical Informatics | Zenwell Health
alicia.stone@zenwellhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0134

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Stone <alicia.stone@zenwellhealth.com>, Tom Becker <t.becker@zenwellhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Aligning stakeholders & timelines for Zenwell evaluation

Thanks Alicia — great to confirm you as champion. Tom, appreciate you joining in.

Updates / commitments from Redwood: 
- Security: Marissa (cc'd, Customer Success) will be the point for SOC 2 evidence and security coordination. We'll add a security contact block to the MAP.
- Eval workspace: We can provision a dedicated evaluation environment with network isolation and scoped datasets. I will share required IP ranges and an onboarding checklist.
- Timeline: Adjusting decision milestone to the week of 10/27 as requested; I updated the MAP accordingly.

Attached is MAP v1 with owner columns filled and a short playbook for the bench tests. Please review owner assignments below and confirm or suggest edits: 
- Clinical acceptance & champion: Alicia Stone (Zenwell)
- Procurement & contracting: Tom Becker (Zenwell)
- Redwood CS lead (security evidence): Marissa Cole (Redwood)
- Redwood AE / project lead: Priyom Das (Redwood)

Proposed immediate next steps (if you agree):
1) Confirm stakeholder roster by 9/15
2) 30-min kickoff sync week of 9/15 to align test prompts (Alicia + Marissa + Priyom + eng SME)
3) Send masked sample payloads and test prompts by 9/19

[Attachment: Zenwell_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf; redwood-eval-checklist.xlsx]

Would you prefer a Tuesday or Thursday slot for the kickoff sync next week? I have availability Tue 9/16 10:00–11:30 PT or Thu 9/18 13:00–15:00 PT.

Thanks — I'll also open a HubSpot MAP record and share the link.

Best,
Priyom Das

pri yom.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 11:43:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Zenwell MAP — next tasks (security + bench prep)

Marissa / Rishi — quick internal note following the exchange with Zenwell (Alicia/Tom). Putting action items here so we have a single trace in the mailbox: 

Action items:
- Marissa: compile SOC 2 artifact list + designate a secure upload link (due 9/18). Customer specifically asked for security contact block in the MAP.
- Rishi: can you draft an example 512-token prompt set and run a quick baseline on quantized 16-bit model so we can show 99th percentile latency numbers by 9/22? If you need GPU time, I can request a dedicated slot.
- Me (Priyom): I will finalize the MAP in HubSpot, send the kickoff invite (prep doc attached), and provision the eval workspace once I have IP ranges from Rishi.

I'll loop you both into the kickoff invite once Priyom confirms Tuesday/Thursday. Please BCC me on the SOC 2 upload so I can keep a copy in the deal record.

Thanks,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
